sample_unit: publicly available pediatric type 1 diabetes datasets

links.outcome: Subgroup-dependent model volatility and disparities hidden by aggregate or balanced-data evaluation
links.effect: Ensemble analyses revealed subgroup-dependent volatility; some groups induced instability despite increased representation; disparities hidden under single-model or balanced-data evaluations.
links.quote: The framework exposes disparities and instability patterns that remain hidden under single-model or balanced-data evaluations.

unlisted_practices: Controlled perturbation of training-data subgroup representation with ensemble training to quantify subgroup-specific training value and prediction stability

screen.reason: Empirically tests and evaluates a pre-deployment auditing framework to assess training data composition effects, fairness, and subgroup disparities across multiple clinical datasets.

primary.practice: pre-deployment algorithmic discrimination and subgroup disparity risk assessment
